text:
mira.cs: Heads-up: VerdantHealth onboarding flagged by our health checks. Multiple p50 latency breaches during their test window this morning. Renewal conversation in 18 days. Can Ops confirm impact and whether this triggers a contractual credit?

infra-bot: [ALERT] service=verdant-inference env=prod region=us-east p50=305ms p90=760ms error_rate=0.12% window=6h link=https://dash.redwood/verdant/session/abc123

sam.ops: Looking now. Preliminary: we dropped to smaller GPU tier after scheduled scale-down; cache warmup failed for a subset of prompt prefixes. Likely cause for elevated p50. ETA 25m for root cause.

mira.cs: Quick ask for CS: prepare short customer message skeleton and a brief credit calc if Ops confirms an SLO hit so we can be transparent in renewal call.

linh.eng: Suggest immediate mitigation: pin route to reserved-fast-pool for 24h and add a 1-replica min to autoscaler to prevent regression. I'll also kick off a synthetic test against their sample prompts to verify.

sam.ops: Ops plan: 1) pin route (cmd below), 2) add min-replicas, 3) run synthetic test; I'll post before/after. Command:
```
redwood route set-pool --route r-8342 --pool reserved-fast-pool --duration 24h --by sam.ops
redwood autoscale update --route r-8342 --min-replicas 1
```

aj.sales: Context: Verdant quoted low-latency as a renewal driver. If we do a fast pin and no customer-visible downtime, sales prefers to avoid an automatic credit if the contract has discretionary language. But be transparent in the comms.

tess.legal: I'll review the contract clauses. Quick note: credits are formulaic; legal can confirm multiplier/cap. Send me the breach window details once you have them.

sam.ops: Running pin now. infra-bot will ingest snapshots.

infra-bot: [ACTION] pool-change initiated by sam.ops at 1755551302 job=job-47b2

sam.ops: Post-mitigation snapshot (10m after): p50=155ms p90=205ms err=0.03% throughput=130rps. Synthetic tests passed against their sample prompts. Uploading graphs.

mira.cs: Thanks. Drafting comms: "We detected a routing/autoscale interaction that increased median latency during your onboarding tests. We pinned your route to a low-latency pool and applied autoscaler changes; metrics now within expected range. We're preparing formal SLO reconciliation and a credit calculation per contract."

mira.cs: Tess/legal, attaching the breach calc:
```
period_days=30
breach_hours=6
breach_fraction=breach_hours/(period_days*24)
credit_pct=breach_fraction*100  # subject to contract caps/multiplier
```

aj.sales: Good. Include a small one-time goodwill gesture in the note (e.g., 1-week Dedicated trial) to smooth renewal discussions. We'll only attach if CS ok.

linh.eng: I'll leave a perf trace and add a temporary alert suppression for 2h to avoid noise. Also saving the synthetic payloads so CS can reproduce locally if Verdant asks.

mira.cs: Proceeding to send the customer note after legal confirms the calc. Sam/linh, please share the before/after images and the synthetic payload. Also add a short onboarding health checklist update for our internal tracker.

sam.ops: Uploaded artifacts to the thread and added checklist item: "verify autoscaler min-replicas for new onboardings".

infra-bot: [NOTE] thread archived by mira.cs at 1755551600
